conceptPrompts.name: 무너진 갱도
conceptPrompts.scene: Scene: an abandoned excavation chamber in the COLLAPSED MINE. An asymmetrical roughly oval cavern whose wall contour follows uneven brown-gray rock, with a broad alcove on the right. A short disused rail enters a timber-supported passage at upper left and curves along the left perimeter into a broken minecart, never bisecting the fighting area. Dark iron ore with subtle cold blue glints emerges from cracks in the right-side rock seam; loose fragments, picks and a wooden bucket gathered at the seam. Broken timber bracing and one empty lantern cage, a couple of small amber work lamps, a cool shadowed upper tunnel and a clear wide lower entrance. No brick palace architecture. The central ground is compacted muted umber soil with a few flatter stone patches, not a tiled field of enormous cobbles. Two tiny readable cave bats hover at the distant upper edge as a scale cue, without active attacks. Feel quiet, abandoned, explorable and slightly dangerous. Warm earth, dark slate, tiny steel-blue ore and amber lamp accents.
conceptPrompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one full-screen dungeon environment concept for the existing Korean Java 2D action RPG "The Hero Does It All".
Input image 1 is a STYLE, CAMERA and ATMOSPHERE REFERENCE, not a layout to trace. Reimagine that camp into the specified dungeon. Preserve the sense of a believable ruined place enclosed by architecture and rock, intimate localized lighting, and a tiny brown-haired adventurer with a red scarf, navy tunic and brown leather boots carrying a separate sword.
Style: beautifully authored 2D pixel-art game environment with crisp stepped contours, readable medium-sized pixel clusters, restrained material detail and 3 to 5 clear shade bands per surface. Less intricate microtexture and less rounded volumetric rendering than the reference. Rich and finished, not a crude miniature, not photorealistic and not a 3D render. Hero and scenery share the same pixel-art visual language.
Camera and composition: wide landscape 16:9 frame, elevated TOP-DOWN three-quarter GAME CAMERA looking into an open-roof room, north at the top, no visible sky, no horizon, no perspective vanishing point, not a diagonal isometric diamond. Show the complete traversable area and distinct entrances. Hero near the lower-middle, about 7% of image height, large enough to read scarf, clothing and weapon.
Playability: a generous contiguous open fighting area occupying approximately the middle half of the image. Quiet, low-contrast floor surfaces; small floor details clustered near edges. Show visually readable room boundaries. Concentrate props, rubble, architectural history and strong detail around the perimeter. All paths wide enough for movement and dodge rolls. No random furniture obstacle in the central combat area.
Lighting: localized pools of light, limited saturated accents, colored light never washes out the hero, restrained bloom, foreground rocks dark but visible. Maintain medium-bright readable combat floor, do not black out most of the picture.
Constraints: one cohesive scene, NOT a collage, no titles, no text, no HUD, no UI, no labels, no logos. Do not include the camp's bed, crafting furnace or campfire. Do not make a uniform rectangular room with repeated giant cobbles. Do not invent new gameplay hazards, traps, loot systems or NPCs. This is a concept image, not a claimed runtime screenshot.

conceptPrompts.name: 저주받은 성채
conceptPrompts.scene: Scene: the CURSED CITADEL's ruined guard hall, a once-orderly medieval stone building broken by time. Retain architectural logic: paired heavy arches, a raised rear gallery behind a visible wall edge, worn gray flagstones and the remains of a faded burgundy runner following a former ceremonial axis. Part of the right wall has collapsed outward into a rubble alcove; one standing column and one broken column belong to the side walls, not the middle. Tattered banners, a discarded shield rack and weathered empty armor stands cluster at the perimeter. A cold dim archway at upper left and an open lower entrance make the route legible. One skeletal guard with a worn sword waits near the rear side, leaving the open floor clear. Subtle blood-moon red mineral traces at the far side suggest corruption, but no red floodlight, no gore, no lava. Palette weathered stone gray, dusty burgundy, desaturated blue shadows, a few soft amber braziers. The broad center uses quiet flat rectangular stone slabs, varied and broken at edges, with a worn faint carpet remnant. The scene should feel like a real ruined fortress room with purpose and history, not a decorative theater stage.

conceptPrompts.name: 마왕의 탑
conceptPrompts.scene: Scene: a high chamber inside the DEMON TOWER, an ancient eight-sided magic observatory/ritual room. A BROAD CONTIGUOUS OCTAGONAL STONE FLOOR fills the middle, safe and open for ranged fights; there are no stepping stones, fragmented floating platforms or holes across its center. Two or three towering square piers sit around the far perimeter. At the outer wall only, broken balustrades reveal lower arches and dark depth inside the tower, giving verticality without changing the game's top-down camera. Inset stone channels with faint violet and pale cyan runes point toward an open rear doorway. A short staircase curls at the far-left perimeter and disappears into masonry; another clear wide entrance is at the lower edge. Thin sky-stone crystal seams, a broken armillary-like ritual ring fragment and a couple of cold flame holders are limited to edge niches. A single small robed demon soldier waits beside the far-right pier, not dominating the composition. Readable broad floor of quiet blue-gray stone, dusty indigo shadows, controlled violet/cyan highlights. Magical and old, not neon, not a science-fiction laboratory, not elaborate gold palace decoration.

conceptPrompts.name: 최종 봉인 전당
conceptPrompts.scene: Scene: the FINAL SEAL HALL beyond the demon tower, the climactic boss arena in the same ancient ruin. A single spacious nearly circular hall with a flattened rear wall, much wider open floor than the other dungeon rooms. A monumental sealed doorway with worn chains rises at the far center behind a low ruined throne dais. Weathered dark stone columns and a few broken monumental carvings frame the sides; rubble stays at the perimeter. A restrained worn circular seal is incised into the broad quiet floor, with sparse muted ivory-gold fragments of light matching the hero's awakened holy sword; no blinding magic disk, no busy concentric graphic overlay. A readable moderately large dark horned armored demon lord silhouette stands at the far edge of the arena in front of the broken throne, about twice the hero's height, with two small subdued ember-red eyes; not a giant character portrait. The brown-haired red-scarf hero stands lower-middle, holding a pale awakened sword with a modest gold edge. Clear entrance steps at the bottom, low near wall so nothing occludes the hero. Dark blue-black architecture, ash-gray floor, limited old gold seal accents and deep wine-red boss accents. Quiet tension and scale, not fireworks, not lava, not a hyper-detailed cathedral. Every part of the central floor remains visually navigable, allowing charges and wide projectile patterns.

cleanPlateEdits.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: production candidate static background plate for a Java/libGDX top-down 2D game.
Edit target: the attached dungeon concept. Make a surgical clean-plate edit only.
Primary request: Remove the single adventurer and separate sword in the lower-middle and all tiny bats inside the top tunnel, including their cast shadows. Reconstruct the same uninterrupted soil and stone ground and the dark tunnel behind them.
Invariants: preserve the original image dimensions, camera, crop, composition, geometry, every doorway and stair position, perimeter wall silhouette, props, texture sharpness, palette, and existing environmental lighting. Keep this scene virtually identical to the source everywhere outside the removed creatures. Do not redesign or simplify the image. The entire environment remains opaque, including the dark exterior. Do not add any replacement character, creature, text, watermark, new opening, new furnishing or HUD. Do not zoom, crop, rotate, shift or relight. Existing lamps, fire, magic channels and crystals stay part of the static artwork at this stage. This must be a clean empty room ready for independently rendered moving characters.
